result.summary: Found 1 visually broken element: a restaurant card in the "Popular right now" section is showing a broken/missing image placeholder instead of a loaded photo.

issues.description: The "Tokumaru Ramen Bar" card displays a generic broken-image placeholder in the main image area, making the card look unfinished and reducing visual clarity.
issues.suggestion: Verify the image asset URL/loading logic and provide a fallback restaurant image or retry state so the card always shows a proper thumbnail.
